cases.title: Startup ping body
cases.description: Smallest request body the chat widget currently sends while checking whether the chatbot backend is alive.

notes: Should not require a user message to pass a basic health check

cases.title: Client function name does not match checked-in folder name
cases.description: The current client calls ai-chatbot, but the checked-in edge function directory is named ai-chat.

notes: At least the client-facing function name must resolve successfully
If only ai-chat exists, either add an alias or update the caller

cases.title: Invalid JSON body
cases.description: Backend should reject malformed JSON before any AI or search work starts.

cases.title: Missing messages field
cases.description: Messages is required for the chat flow and should produce a readable error.

cases.title: Empty messages array
cases.description: An empty conversation array should be treated the same as a missing messages payload.

cases.title: Whitespace system prompt override
cases.description: Blank override values should fall back to the default system prompt instead of sending an empty system message upstream.

notes: systemPrompt should fall back to the default prompt
Groq request should still contain a valid system message

cases.title: Temperature above max as a string
cases.description: String temperatures higher than 1 should be clamped before the Groq request is sent.

notes: Request should not fail because the input arrived as a string

cases.title: Temperature below min as a string

notes: Request should stay deterministic instead of erroring

cases.title: Explicitly disabled web search
cases.description: When includeWebSearch is false, the function should skip Tavily even if a key is present.

messages.content: What happened in the latest Dune movie?

notes: The AI response should still come back from Groq

cases.title: Custom web search query override
cases.description: The backend should prefer webSearchQuery over the last message content when Tavily search is enabled.

body.webSearchQuery: Dune Part Two box office and reviews

notes: Tavily query should use the override string
Returned webSources should correspond to the override topic when search succeeds

cases.title: Tavily failure should not break the chat reply
cases.description: Search is optional and should fail open when Tavily is unavailable or throws.

notes: Assistant content should still be returned
webSources may be empty if Tavily fails

cases.title: Missing GROQ secret
cases.description: Without GROQ_API_KEY, the edge function should fail fast with a clear configuration error.

cases.title: Groq upstream non-200 response
cases.description: Groq errors should be passed back as JSON instead of being hidden behind a generic success response.

notes: Response body should contain the upstream Groq error payload
Caller should receive a non-200 status
